title: A Mechanism Study of Delayed Loss Spikes in Batch-Normalized Linear Models
summary: Delayed loss spikes have been reported in neural-network training, but existing theory mainly explains earlier non-monotone behavior caused by overly large fixed learning rates. We study one stylized hypothesis: normalization can postpone instability by gradually increasing the effective learning rate during otherwise stable descent. To test this hypothesis at theorem level, we analyze batch-normalized linear models.
